pairs.note:
2:09 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 83 degrees, relative humidity 59 percent, barometer 30.06 inches, adjusted altitude 2,209 feet, track temperature 112 degrees.

Vandergriff gets the advantage off of the line but he loses a cylinder early in the run. The chute deploys about 700 feet out. Green goes down the groove with a good run to take the win.

Green is going to his fifth career final round and is the defending Gatornationals Funny Car champion.

DeJoria is 10 - 8 against Todd in prior events. 

Todd double-steps the throttle and turns on the red bulb giving the win DeJoria. DeJoria goes down the groove with a clean pass to take the win.

DeJoria is going to her 17th career final round. She will give up lane choice to Green in the final round.
